newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Arbitrage sale batters SIMEX Nikkei to weak finish.
newsitem.headline: Arbitrage sale batters SIMEX Nikkei to weak finish.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures were battered lower on Thursday following a large arbitrage sale by a European trading house in the morning, dealers said.
After opening at 21,310, SIMEX Nikkei 225 December tumbled lower after the fixed interest arbitrage sale and broke its major technical support at 21,190.
The contract eroded further to close at 21,075, down 260 points from Wednesday. Turnover was at 22,035 lots.
Dealers said the overnight correction on Wall street and the 1.7 percent month-to-month drop seen in Japan's industrial production output in November also dampened sentiment.
"Japan's industrial production data was of some concern today as it either negates or reaffirms Wednesday's tankan," a dealer said.
"Today's data reinforced belief that the Bank of Japan is unlikely to hike rates in the near-term," he said, adding that the news was good for the bonds, not stocks.
